"Then prove it on the field," you write. {npc}'s answer: "Gladly."

events.text: A year after your last fight, a parcel comes from {npc} with no letter: {his} first practice sword, the one from when you were six, snapped cleanly in two. You understand. {He} will not be born beside you again.

events.text: The first year of the peace, {npc} comes to your door at the festival with a lantern and two rice cakes. "I did not know what to do with a festival when there was nobody to beat," {he} admits. "So I came to you."

effects.log: You walk the festival lanterns until midnight like two people who have nothing left to prove.

choices.text: Spar, for fun, for the first time

effects.log: You spar with nothing at stake. It is the best fight either of you has ever had, and nobody wins.

choices.text: Introduce {him} to your household as an old friend

events.text: {npc} is six again, and so are you, and this time {he} runs to you across the whole village and throws {his} arms around you. "You came back!" {he} says. "Friends in every life. You promised."

"Same night," says {npc}. "Same village. I will find you." You believe it.

events.text: At the gate of the Tower, as you set your foot on the first worn stair, someone sets theirs on the stair beside you. It is {npc}. Of course it is. "I wondered when you would come," {he} says. "I am not waiting for you. I am only climbing at the same speed."

{npc} matches your pace exactly, stair for stair. It will be like this the whole way up.
